Hi Paul,

I'm sorry about this. You've already waited since late October for one small part, and now the replacement hasn't turned up either.

I checked the shipment. The carrier marked the stand on order Shop···· as delivered on November 13. You've told me you never got it and that your camera shows no vehicle stopping at your house at that time, so I'm treating it as not received.

I've passed it to the team with your tracking details, your footage note and your (address hidden). They'll open a trace with the carrier and work out how to get the base to you. They're offline for the weekend, so they'll pick it up Monday at 10am ET and reply here by email. You don't need to do anything else. If a neighbour turns up with the parcel before then, just reply here and let us know.

Kind regards,
